description: repos/** is the vendored read-only Effect reference subtree and is never Renovate's to update (#108); the other ignorePaths restate config:recommended's :ignoreModulesAndTests, which setting ignorePaths replaces. Effect stays pinned to its 4.0.0-rc line (bumped deliberately with migration review), agent-bundle and effect-rstest track pkg.pr.new preview URLs, and typescript is pinned by the tsgo integration; Renovate manages the rest on a weekly schedule.
